raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

At batch size 1 on the Kimi-K3 TP8 fused MoE path, the shared-expert output gets its own low-SM pull all-reduce on the side stream. The latent then goes through the deferred-finalize push all-reduce + RMSNorm. Both collectives move tiny tensors, and the push all-reduce has headroom for the shared rows. This PR folds the shared-expert partials into the finalize push so both ride one collective, which removes one all-reduce launch per MoE layer per decode step.

## Modifications

- `ar_fusion.cuh`, `finalize_push_norm`: in the finalize variant, stage 1 finalizes the leading latent rows from the trtllm-gen deferred-finalize triple. Any trailing rows are staged from `out` as rank-local partials. Only the latent rows are RMSNormed. The host accepts either a latent-only `[T * 3584]` output or a flattened `[latent | shared]` `[3T * 3584]` output, and sizes the row-cluster grid from the total row count.
- `kimi_k3.py`, `_forward_fused`: when the deferred finalize is active, `num_tokens == 1`, and three rows fit the push window, skip the side-stream `all_reduce_low_sm` on `shared_output` and pass the whole `[latent | shared]` symmetric buffer to `finalize_all_reduce_push_norm`.
- Docstrings updated in `all_reduce_residual.py` and `k3_ar_fusion.py`.

The path is gated on the existing deferred finalize (`flashinfer_mxfp4` + SiTU, the Blackwell default), so it is active on B200/B300 TP8 MXFP4. Other batch sizes are unchanged.

## Accuracy Tests

B300 1×8, TP8, `moonshotai/Kimi-K3` MXFP4, the cookbook B300 Unified Low-Latency recipe (`--tp-size 8 --mem-fraction-static 0.85`, attention/MoE backends auto-resolved). GSM8K (`sglang.test.few_shot_gsm8k`, 1319 questions, 5-shot):

| Run | main | this PR |
|---|---|---|
| Full set, `--parallel 64` | 0.951 (invalid 0.001) | 0.951 (invalid 0.001) |
| First 250, `--parallel 1` (batch size 1, exercises this path) | 0.988 (247/250) | 0.980 (245/250) |

The batch-size-1 delta is 2 questions out of 250, within one standard error (~0.9 pt) at this sample size. Reduction order for the shared rows changes (summed inside the push all-reduce instead of a separate pull all-reduce), so greedy outputs can diverge in a few places. A full 1319-question batch-size-1 run is still to do before this leaves draft.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Same setup. `bench_one_batch_server`, batch size 1, input 8192, output 1024, three repetitions per arm on the same server:

| Output throughput (tok/s) | rep 1 | rep 2 | rep 3 |
|---|---|---|---|
| main | 118.72 | 119.28 | 119.17 |
| this PR | 119.58 | 119.46 | 119.50 |

Decode is +0.2–0.3% on B300 (main's rep 1 includes first-request warmup). The gain is small on B300 because the separate shared-expert all-reduce already ran on the side stream, overlapped with the routed experts. What this PR saves is one launch and one synchronization per layer.

Kernel counts from a TP0 torch-profiler trace (batch size 1, 1024 input, 5 profiled steps):

| Kernel | main | this PR |
|---|---|---|
| `all_reduce_pull_res_kernel` | 553 | 185 (−368, one per MoE layer per decode step) |
| `all_reduce_push_norm_cluster_kernel` | 368 × 8.14 µs | 368 × 8.06 µs (now also carries the shared rows) |
| Total kernels | 11393 | 11025 |

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

@@ -275,9 +275,12 @@ def finalize_all_reduce_push_norm(
     weight: torch.Tensor,
     eps: float,
 ) -> torch.Tensor:
-    """Deferred MoE finalize + 1shot push all-reduce + RMSNorm on EVERY row.
+    """Deferred MoE finalize + 1shot push all-reduce + latent RMSNorm.
 
-    ``out`` ([T, 3584] bf16) is output-only; each rank's partial latent
+    ``out`` is [T, 3584] bf16, or flattened [latent | shared] with 3*T rows
+    of width 3584. Optional shared rows must contain rank-local sums; they
+    are reduced without normalization. Leading latent rows are output-only;
+    each rank's partial latent
     (``sum_k expert_weights[t, k] * gemm2_out[idx[t*16 + k]]``, -1 slots
     skipped) is computed during the multicast staging pass from the
     trtllm-gen deferred-finalize triple (``do_finalize=False``) and never

@@ -365,8 +365,11 @@ def finalize_all_reduce_push_norm(
     weight: torch.Tensor,
     eps: float = 1e-6,
 ) -> torch.Tensor:
-    """Deferred MoE finalize fused into the 1shot push AR + RMSNorm; ``out`` is
-    output-only. Caller checked :func:`finalize_push_fits`."""
+    """Finalize and reduce the latent, optionally reducing trailing shared rows.
+
+    Only the leading latent is normalized and output-only. Any trailing
+    shared rows must contain rank-local sums. Caller checked
+    :func:`finalize_push_fits`."""
     from sglang.kernels.ops.communication import all_reduce_residual as mod
 
     state = _get_state()

@@ -1384,6 +1384,13 @@ def _forward_fused(
                 and self.fuse_ar_norm
                 and k3_ar_fusion.finalize_push_fits(num_tokens)
             )
+            # BS1: stage shared partials with the deferred latent finalize so
+            # both ride one collective.
+            joint_finalize = (
+                defer_finalize
+                and num_tokens == 1
+                and k3_ar_fusion.finalize_push_fits(3 * num_tokens)
+            )
             current_stream = torch.cuda.current_stream()
             self.alt_stream.wait_stream(current_stream)
             if defer_finalize:
@@ -1396,7 +1403,10 @@ def _forward_fused(
                 self._forward_shared(gate_up, shared_output)
                 # low-SM pull so the side-stream AR leaves the SMs to the
                 # routed GEMMs it overlaps (K3 dims are fixed; tuned here)
-                k3_ar_fusion.all_reduce_low_sm(shared_output, num_blocks=4, unroll=8)
+                if not joint_finalize:
+                    k3_ar_fusion.all_reduce_low_sm(
+                        shared_output, num_blocks=4, unroll=8
+                    )
             current_stream.wait_stream(self.alt_stream)
             # The latent AR must stay serialized after the shared AR (both
             # reuse the v2 pull semaphores); the join above does it.
@@ -1405,7 +1415,7 @@ def _forward_fused(
                 # covers every latent row
                 fused_norm = True
                 k3_ar_fusion.finalize_all_reduce_push_norm(
-                    latent,
+                    buf if joint_finalize else latent,
                     deferred.gemm2_out,
                     deferred.expanded_idx_to_permuted_idx,
                     deferred.expert_weights,
